name: Piri-piri chicken and slaw
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical 1.5 kg whole roasted chicken (about 300-400 g edible meat per person after bone/skin loss) plus slaw volume for 4 adult portions as a main meal with sides.
Total time sums active prep (marinade ~10 min, slaw ~10 min) + passive times (1 h marinade + 80 min roast + 20 min rest) rounded to nearest 10; oven pre-heat included in roast time.
Mayonnaise assumed to contain egg (standard); Greek yogurt contains milk; no wheat, fish, shellfish, nuts, peanuts, soy, or sesame detected in listed ingredients.
Gluten-free true because no barley/rye/wheat/oats listed and all spices/herbs are single-ingredient; dairy-free false due to yogurt (and possibly mayo).
Oil type unspecified but treated as neutral (no allergen impact); vinegar and all vegetables/spices compatible with listed diets where marked true.
instructions:
STEP 1

Whizz together all of the marinade ingredients in a small food processor. Rub the marinade onto the chicken and leave for 1 hour at room temperature.

STEP 2

Heat the oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Put the chicken in a roasting tray and cook for 1 hour 20 minutes. Rest under loose foil for 20 minutes. While the chicken is resting, mix together the slaw ingredients and season. Serve the chicken with slaw, fries and condiments.

ingredients.name: Chicken
ingredients.assumptions: Raw whole chicken with skin and bone; typical values for a 1.5 kg bird including skin as the recipe roasts it whole.

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium red chillies (about 40 g each) chopped; raw edible portion.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 2 average garlic cloves (3 g each), raw.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp grated fresh ginger root, raw.

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp smoked or sweet paprika powder.

ingredients.name: Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbs red wine vinegar (15 ml per tbs).

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbs neutral oil for the marinade (14 g per tbs); olive or vegetable oil.

ingredients.name: Red Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red onion (110 g), raw and sliced; entire edible portion used in slaw.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium carrots (61 g each), raw; peeled and grated for slaw.

ingredients.name: Beetroot
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium beetroot (82 g), raw; peeled and grated for slaw.

ingredients.name: Cabbage
ingredients.assumptions: 4 large outer leaves of white cabbage (30 g each), raw and shredded for slaw.

ingredients.name: Mayonnaise
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbs mayonnaise (15 g per tbs); full-fat standard variety.

ingredients.name: Greek Yogurt
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbs plain Greek yogurt (15 g per tbs); full-fat.

ingredients.name: Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbs red wine vinegar for the slaw dressing (15 ml per tbs).
